 Gold Rate Today Hyderabad: Prices Fall On October 23 
 Gold Rate Today  | Hyderabad, Oct 23: Gold Rate Today Hyderabad declined on Friday, October 23, 2026 , with prices falling across 22 carat, 24 carat and 18 carat gold .
 The supplied rates show that 22 carat gold fell by ₹1,750 to ₹1,30,600 per 10 grams. Meanwhile, 24 carat gold dropped by ₹1,900 to ₹1,42,480 per 10 grams.
 The price of 18 carat gold also declined by ₹1,430 to ₹1,06,860 per 10 grams.
 Gold Rate Today Hyderabad: Silver and Platinum Prices
 Silver in Hyderabad is priced at ₹2,25,000 per kilogram. Platinum is trading at ₹4,757 per gram, according to the supplied rates.
